mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REQUEST_HISTORY (REQUEST_ID, OLD_STATUS, NEW_STATUS, REVIEW_COMMENT, CHANGED_AT, CHANGED_BY) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{oldStatus}, #{newStatus}, #{reviewComment}, #{changedAt}, #{changedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT ID, REQUEST_ID, OLD_STATUS, NEW_STATUS, REVIEW_COMMENT, CHANGED_AT, CHANGED_BY FROM REQUEST_HISTORY WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} ORDER BY CHANGED_AT, ID
